event.summary: Senator Lindsey Graham was remembered during a funeral service at the Washington National Cathedral. timeline.title: Trump Honors Lindsey Graham at National Cathedral Memorial Service
timeline.summary: President Donald Trump paid tribute to the late Senator Lindsey Graham during a memorial service at the Washington National Cathedral. In his remarks, Trump highlighted Graham's significant influence in Washington over the past 30 years, stating that 'nothing of consequence happened in this capital without Lindsey Graham knowing about it.'
key_facts: Trump delivered remarks at Graham's memorial service.
